children: Stock futures are dropping after early vote counts suggest a big night for Democrats. Contracts linked to the Nasdaq 100 are down more than 1%, while S&P 500 futures are also in the red.
Changes in futures prices don't always reflect market moves after the opening bell.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
